title: Battle Casualty Soldier During Kargil War Cannot Be Denied Benefits Because Injury Occurred Outside Kargil Sector: J&K&L High Court
description: The High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh has held that a soldier who has admittedly been declared a Battle Casualty and invalidated out of military service during Operation Vijay cannot be denied ex-gratia financial assistance under a welfare scheme merely because his injuries were sustained outside the geographical limits of the Kargil Sector.
